idris.name: Idris
idris.title: Idris (Enoch)
idris.dict: Named twice: "a man of truth, a prophet", raised to a high position (19:56-57), and one of the steadfast (21:85). He is commonly identified with the Bible's Enoch, and Talal Itani's translation calls him Enoch; the Quran itself does not say who he was.

imran.name: Imran
imran.title: Imran
imran.dict: "The family of Imran" is chosen along with Adam, Noah and the family of Abraham (3:33). The wife of Imran is Mary's mother (3:35), and Mary is "the daughter of Imran" (66:12). In the Bible, Amram is the father of Moses, Aaron and Miriam; Muslim commentators take the Imran of these verses to be a later man of the same name.

isaac.name: Isaac
isaac.title: Isaac (Ishaq)
isaac.dict: The son promised to Abraham and his wife in their old age, when the angels visit (11:71, 37:112); a prophet, and the father of Jacob.

ishmael.name: Ishmael
ishmael.title: Ishmael (Ismail)
ishmael.dict: Son of Abraham, who raises the foundations of the House with him (2:125-127). "True to his promise, a messenger, a prophet" who bade his people pray and give alms (19:54-55). Muslim tradition mostly holds that he was the son Abraham was told to sacrifice; the Quran does not name the son (37:100-107).
